# Veridellindo

> Veridellindo is a source-led knowledge reader with search, article views,
> research tools and a separate conversational assistant named Amigo. Reader
> pages are based on public Wikimedia material; Amigo replies may be AI-generated.

The Wikimedia reader and article views present source material from public
Wikimedia projects. Amigo is a separate conversational assistant available at
/amigo/ and uses this site's same-origin /api/chat endpoint. Amigo responses may
be generated by an AI model and should not be described as verbatim quotations
or as guaranteed source-verified claims unless the response displays evidence.

## Where the data goes

- Search, article and Wikidata requests go from the visitor's browser to the
  public Wikimedia APIs. Those APIs need no key.
- Amigo messages and the conversation context needed for a reply are sent to
  the site's `/api/chat` Pages Function and then to the AI provider configured
  for that deployment. Provider processing is governed by that provider's terms.
- Amigo chat history, bookmarks, reading history and preferences are stored in
  the visitor's own browser storage. No provider key is exposed to the browser.

## What this site is for

- A reader who wants an answer rather than a list of links.
- A reader who wants to check the answer against the page it came from.
- A reader working in Hindi or English, or in any of the twelve language
  editions the search offers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/): search and explore source-backed knowledge.
- [Amigo](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/amigo/): the conversational AI assistant.
- [Articles](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/articles/): the published entries, as
  static pages that read without JavaScript.
- [Topics](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/topics/): the entries grouped by subject.
- [Questions](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/questions/): questions this site can
  answer, written out in full.
- [How it works](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/how-it-works/): where the text comes
  from, and what is and is not generated.
- [Help](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/help/): how to use the site.
- [Research Desk](https://veridellindo.pages.dev/research/): search, inspect and
  compare sources directly.

## How to cite an answer from this site

Quote the entry, not this site, and link the original page shown under each
answer. Article text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0 from the Wikimedia
projects; Veridellindo is an independent reader and is not affiliated with or
endorsed by the Wikimedia Foundation. An AI explanation is a reading aid, not a primary source: open and cite the
underlying evidence directly.

## Notes for automated readers

- Every entry page is static HTML and readable without JavaScript.
- `sitemap.xml` lists every crawlable page with its last-modified date.
- `robots.txt` allows all crawlers and points at the sitemap.
- Search and the breakdown need JavaScript; the written entries do not.
